# Sconce

Type: Furniture | Internal ID: piece_walltorch | Source: Forge | Crafting Materials: Wood x2, Copper x2, Resin x2 | Weak to (x1.5): Blunt | Neutral to (x1): Chop, ,, Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Pierce, ,, Slash | Immune to (x0): Poison, ,, Spirit

# Introduction

The Sconce is a light source that can be built using the Hammer within range of a Forge. It requires Resin as fuel.
It can hold up to 6 Resin at once. With 1/6 fuel, a Sconce will last for 5 hours and 33 minutes. At maximum capacity a Sconce should burn for 33 hours and 20 minutes. This duration is the same for the Standing iron torch, Standing green-burning iron torch and Standing blue-burning iron torch, and lasts longer than the Standing wood torch. Sconces need to be 1m below a ceiling from the middle point of the wood diamond or they will turn off.
A Sconce mounted outside will not be extinguished by a rainstorm.

Categorias: Furniture, Light sources
